line: A clean isometric gate, jet bridge and cabin where faceless travellers board in order, serif words land on the floor and a paper roof flips open, so the order of movement explains why one way fills 72 seats in nearly half the time.
line_cn: 干净的等距登机口、廊桥和机舱，背影小人按顺序登机，衬线大字落在地上，机舱顶盖像纸盖一样翻开；动的顺序本身就讲清了为什么换一种叫法能快将近一半。
uses: Comparing two ways of doing it
